decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposal would not harm the appearance of the area or neighbours' living conditions, and would provide improved education facilities without harm to local highway safety, traffic or parking conditions in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), C.2.1(Educational Facilities), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities) and ENV-N.1.11(Protection and Improvement of Local Open Space) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Removal of temporary classrooms and erection of a single storey nursery/reception building to side with connecting covered corridor to main building.
